name: Book of Artisans: a profession rank the character's skill already reached is neither sold nor shown
contract: A trainer rank row (Journeyman/Expert/Artisan Woodworker 1005015-1005017) teaches a rank spell (1005009-1005011) whose SPELL_EFFECT_SKILL grants a skill maximum of step x 75 (150, 225, 300). Trainer::GetSpellState read a row as known only when the character had that exact rank spell, so a character whose Woodworking is already 300/300 without those spells - raised by another route, such as the Tradesman's Scroll, which only teaches ranks above the current step - kept being offered all three ranks as available. A rank whose granted maximum the character's pure maximum already reaches is now known, so it cannot be bought. It is also left out of the window: the 3.3.5 client re-reads a known row as available whenever the character learns any spell and it does not hold the row's learned spell, so a row sent as known turned green again after the next recipe was trained. Expected: with Woodworking 300/300 and only the apprentice spell, the three Woodworker ranks are not rows (-1), before and after a recipe is bought from the book; with Tailoring 60/75, Journeyman Tailor (maximum 150) is still available (0).
